scope: Third preregistered neural open-loop screen of round 12: reciprocal inhibition between the two tripod groups plus enhanced spike-frequency adaptation on the PREMOTOR leg pools (never on motor neurons, which are strict sinks). Existing edges only, per-row renormalised 0.020 uS. No physics, no learning, no new edges, no external oscillator.
why: Screen 2 (../halfcenter/) found that reciprocal inhibition plus reduced cross-excitation drives the tripod score from -0.624 to at most +0.090, but only by silencing group A to 0.2 Hz while group B stays near 8 Hz: winner-take-all suppression, not alternation, and it failed the preregistered 'both groups > 2 Hz' condition. The classical half-centre needs an escape mechanism, and this module's escape candidate is spike-frequency adaptation. Round 11 showed that scaling adaptation on motor neurons cannot work because all 323 MNs are graph sinks, so the adaptation must act on the premotor leg pools.
mechanism: Two changes to the frozen core, both on existing structure only: (a) existing A<->B tripod-group edge conductances re-weighted per direction and renormalised per row, (b) the per-spike adaptation increment of neurons in the six leg-specific premotor pools (buckets pool_lf..pool_rm, 4,286 neurons) multiplied by a fixed scalar. Motor neurons and all other neurons keep the frozen adaptation.

fixed.note: cross-excitation reduced symmetrically; screen 2's asymmetric reduction is not reused because it also silenced one group

grid.rule: complete factorial (inh_AB = inh_BA in this screen); every combination run and reported

protocol: Identical to screens 1-2: canonical 2000-step state, 400 bins x 5 ms of recorded sensory replay, zero descending current, 323 exported MN rates recorded every 5 ms. Physical steps 0.
fixed_analysis: Same metric definitions as screens 1-2 and round-11 intrinsic: tripod alternation score = -corr(mean(A), mean(B)), ipsilateral score, LF-RH and RF-LH correlations, per-leg means, group means, PC1 variance fraction and loadings.
decision_rule_fixed_in_advance: ALTERNATION-POSITIVE only if tripod score >= 0.30, both tripod-group mean rates > 2 Hz, and both LF-RH and RF-LH correlations are negative. A positive result licenses only a further preregistered physical experiment; it is not walking, not a gait, and not a biological claim. All-negative must be reported as negative.
guards: With every scalar 1 the matrices must equal the frozen ones and behaviour must be bit-identical to the frozen core before the grid.
limits: Open-loop neural replay only; no body, contact or sensorimotor loop. Scalars are uncalibrated engineering weights; the half-centre plus adaptation mechanism is a modelling hypothesis, not a measurement of fly circuitry; the pool definitions come from direct strict-graph MN projection and are not anatomical cell types. Nothing here is a lesion or surgical model.
